title: A person's DENY is crossed only through Orbit Control's door, and an approval binds exactly one action
goal: crossing() lets an AUTO action through for anybody, lets a person's DENY through only for an actor at Orbit Control's door -- never a terminal, a typed-back id, a flag, another door or nobody -- and never lets an approve-once action through at all; and the fingerprint an approval is bound to, through fingerprintOf(requestOf(...)) and actionFingerprint(), changes whenever a field the boundary binds, the boundary, the operation or the asking tool changes, and stays the same for what is only shown, an identity riding along, or the same fields in another order
reproduce: every failing check names the action and the actor it crossed, or the two actions whose fingerprints it compared, what the contract expects and what came back; the probe imports the subject's own authorize module and answers in its own process
